lines.1: 「So anyway, highways are free in some other countries. Japan's got this stuff all wrong. We ought to learn from the rest of the world.」
lines.3: 「Hey. That sheet hasn't moved for a while. It's gone completely limp.」
lines.6: 「D-Does this look alive to you, moron...? You made me have a near-death experience... Some weird old lady was beckoning me over, and I almost got on her boat...」
lines.8: 「Either way, I'm getting revenge. Huge revenge. Anyway, I'm using your bathroom.」
lines.10: 「Huh? Crying again, Crab? You cry at the drop of a hat, man.」
lines.11: 「I'm not a man! Anyway, I'm using your bathroom.」
lines.13: 「Here, a tissue. You've got tears in your eyes.」
lines.14: 「I-I'm not crying. I'm not! Anyway, I'm using your bathroom.」
lines.16: Damn, that was one petty little campaign of harassment.
lines.18: Well, none of us really thought of Crab as a girl.
lines.20: Still, having her around beat four guys stinking up the place.
lines.21: 「Speaking of which, did you fill out your career survey?」
lines.22: 「Yep. I filled it in the moment they handed it out.」
lines.23: 「Inori gets on your case if you don't turn that stuff in quickly.」
lines.24: 「...Words like 'career' are way too real. I hate it.」
lines.25: Fukahire plucked a guitar string with a sharp twang.
lines.26: The four of us would gather like this, shoot the breeze, and mess around.
lines.27: This was our everyday life, exactly as it was.
lines.29: And yet, they were happy days.
lines.30: A life like this would go on forever.
lines.31: At least, that was what we believed.
